headline: Samsung Galaxy A27 priced at $349.99, a budget phone with compromises
summary: The Galaxy A27 has a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display, 6GB of RAM, 128GB of storage, and a 5,000mAh battery.
details: The Samsung Galaxy A27 will be available on July 14 in the US, priced at $349.99. It features a 6.7-inch Super AMOLED display with a 120Hz refresh rate, 6GB of RAM, 128GB of storage, and a 5,000mAh battery. The phone has a 12MP front-facing camera, 2MP macro camera, and 5MP ultra-wide camera.

Compared to its predecessor, the Galaxy A26, the A27 has a lower-resolution front-facing camera (12MP vs 13MP) and ultra-wide camera (5MP vs 8MP). The A27 also has a lower IP rating for water resistance (IP64 vs IP67).
The Galaxy A27 has a faster processor with the Snapdragon Gen 3 chipset, compared to the Galaxy A26's Exynos 1380. The phone will be available in only one color, black, in the US.

The price increase and compromises in the Galaxy A27 reflect the current challenges in the tech industry, including a RAM shortage and increasing costs. This trend is also seen in other companies, such as Apple, which recently announced price hikes for its MacBooks and iPads.

headline_marked: Microsoft hikes Xbox Series console prices by $100-$150 [[third hike in two years]]
headline: Microsoft hikes Xbox Series console prices by $100-$150 third hike in two years
summary: Xbox Series console prices increase, 2TB model discontinued
details: Microsoft is increasing the prices of its Xbox Series consoles for the third time in two years. The 512GB versions will see a $100 price hike, while the 1TB model will increase by $150.
The price changes will take effect on August 1st. The 2TB version of the Xbox Series X has been discontinued, with current stock priced at $799.99.
Microsoft is also introducing new payment options, including 'Buy Now, Pay Later' through Klarna and interest-free 12-month financing on Amazon.
The company is expanding its Xbox trade-in program, allowing players to sell their consoles to retailers for cash or store credit.
caption:
